verdict.rationale: A is reasonable if the sign-off ends near 12:45, since the stated drive and carry-on status leave a conventional preflight window. D is also reasonable because it protects against follow-up and preserves a nonstop itinerary, but it costs more and delays arrival. B and C can be justified by different balances of extra local-time buffer, savings, connection risk, and later arrival. The query supplies no priority among those trade-offs, so no option clearly dominates.
